SubmissionStatus

SubmissionStatus.Rd

A SubmissionStatus is a secondary, mutable object associated with a Submission. This object should be used to contain scoring data about the Submission. https://rest-docs.synapse.org/rest/org/sagebionetworks/evaluation/model/SubmissionStatus.html

Usage

SubmissionStatus(id=NULL, etag=NULL, modified_on=NULL, status=NULL, score=NULL, report=NULL, annotations=list(), submission_annotations=list(), private_status_annotations=TRUE, entity_id=NULL, version_number=NULL, status_version=NULL, can_cancel=FALSE, cancel_requested=FALSE)

Format

An S3-style class object.

Arguments

id

(Optional[character]) The unique, immutable Synapse ID of the Submission.

etag

(Optional[character]) Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme to handle concurrent updates. The eTag changes every time a SubmissionStatus is updated; it is used to detect when a client's copy of a SubmissionStatus is out-of-date.

modified_on

(Optional[character]) The date on which this SubmissionStatus was last modified.

status

(Optional[character]) The possible states of a Synapse Submission (e.g., RECEIVED, VALIDATED, SCORED).

score

(Optional[numeric]) This field is deprecated and should not be used. Use the 'submission_annotations' field instead.

report

(Optional[character]) This field is deprecated and should not be used. Use the 'submission_annotations' field instead.

annotations

(Optional[dict[str, Union[list[str], list[bool], list[float], list[int], list[date], list[datetime]]]]) Primary container object for Annotations on a Synapse object. These annotations use the legacy format and do not show up in a submission view. The visibility is controlled by private_status_annotations.

submission_annotations

(Optional[dict[str, Union[list[str], list[bool], list[float], list[int], list[date], list[datetime]]]]) Submission Annotations are additional key-value pair metadata that are associated with an object. These annotations use the modern nested format and show up in a submission view.

private_status_annotations

(Optional[logical]) Indicates whether the annotations (not to be confused with submission annotations) are private (TRUE) or public (FALSE). Default is TRUE. This controls the visibility of the 'annotations' field.

entity_id

(Optional[character]) The Synapse ID of the Entity in this Submission.

version_number

(Optional[integer]) The version number of the Entity in this Submission.

status_version

(Optional[integer]) A version of the status, auto-generated and auto-incremented by the system and read-only to the client.

can_cancel

(Optional[logical]) Can this submission be cancelled? By default, this will be set to FALSE. Users can read this value. Only the queue's scoring application can change this value.

cancel_requested

(Optional[logical]) Has user requested to cancel this submission? By default, this will be set to FALSE. Submission owner can read and request to change this value.

Value

NULL

Methods

  • SubmissionStatus(id=NULL, etag=NULL, modified_on=NULL, status=NULL, score=NULL, report=NULL, annotations=list(), submission_annotations=list(), private_status_annotations=TRUE, entity_id=NULL, version_number=NULL, status_version=NULL, can_cancel=FALSE, cancel_requested=FALSE): Constructor for SubmissionStatus

  • synBatchUpdateSubmissionStatuses(evaluation_id, statuses, is_first_batch=TRUE, is_last_batch=TRUE, batch_token=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Update multiple SubmissionStatuses. The maximum batch size is 500.

  • synGetAllSubmissionStatuses(evaluation_id, status=NULL, limit=10L, offset=0L, synapse_client=NULL): Gets a collection of SubmissionStatuses to a specified Evaluation.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Retrieve and update a SubmissionStatus.
    # This example demonstrates the basic workflow of retrieving an existing submission status, updating its fields, and storing the changes back to Synapse.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Get a submission status
    status = SubmissionStatus(id = "9999999") |> synGet()

    # Update the status
    status$status = "SCORED"
    status$submission_annotations = list(score = list(85.5), feedback = list("Good work!"))
    status = status |> synStore()
    print(status)

## Example 2: Get all submission statuses for an evaluation.
    # Retrieve multiple submission statuses for an evaluation queue with optional filtering.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Get all RECEIVED statuses for an evaluation
    statuses = synGetAllSubmissionStatuses(
        evaluation_id = "9999999",
        status = "RECEIVED",
        limit = 100L
    )

    print(sprintf("Found %d submission statuses", length(statuses)))
    for (status in statuses) {
        print(sprintf("Status ID: %s, Status: %s", status$id, status$status))
    }

## Example 3: Batch update multiple submission statuses.
    # Efficiently update multiple submission statuses in a single operation.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Retrieve statuses to update
    statuses = synGetAllSubmissionStatuses(
        evaluation_id = "9999999",
        status = "RECEIVED"
    )

    # Update each status
    for (status in statuses) {
        status$status = "SCORED"
        status$submission_annotations = list(
            validation_score = 95.0,
            comments = "Passed validation"
        )
    }

    # Batch update all statuses
    response = synBatchUpdateSubmissionStatuses(
        evaluation_id = "9999999",
        statuses = statuses
    )
    print(response)
} # }
